title: Fishing Set with Storage Box – Complete Fishing Tackle Set
descriptionHtml:
Everything for fishing – in one box

Getting started with fishing takes a lot of small parts: hooks, baits, lines and much more. Buying everything separately gets both expensive and messy.

Complete set with storage

This fishing set includes everything from soft and hard baits to hooks, lures and a waist bag. It all stores neatly in the included box – perfect as a gift or a beginner's set.

Features

  • Complete set with many pieces
  • Hooks, baits, lures and lines included
  • With storage box and waist bag
  • Good for both beginners and experienced anglers
  • A popular gift idea

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
